item.title: Pakistan flood death toll rises as monsoon rains continue
item.description: Officials in Pakistan say the death toll from monsoon flooding has climbed as heavy rains continue across southern provinces.

item.title: India's central bank holds interest rates steady
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged, citing balanced inflation and growth risks.

item.title: Bangladesh garment workers stage protest over unpaid wages
item.description: Thousands of garment factory workers in Dhaka protested demanding months of unpaid wages be released immediately.

item.title: Pakistan and Afghanistan officials meet in Doha over border row
item.description: Representatives from Pakistan and Afghanistan held talks in Doha aimed at defusing tensions along their shared border.

item.title: Sri Lanka reports rise in tourist arrivals this quarter
item.description: Sri Lanka's tourism board reported a notable increase in foreign visitor arrivals compared to the same period last year.

item.title: Indonesia hit by moderate earthquake, no major damage reported
item.description: A moderate earthquake struck off the coast of Indonesia on Thursday, though authorities reported no major damage or injuries.
